tagline.en: GigaAI's GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 — a world-action VLA that pairs an action-centered Mixture-of-Transformers with a diffusion action loop.
tagline.zh: GigaAI 的 GigaWorld-Policy-0.5——世界-动作型 VLA,将以动作为中心的 Mixture-of-Transformers 与扩散动作循环结合。

en: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 is a vision-language-action policy from GigaAI (open-gigaai) in the world-action model family. It predicts robot actions and is built around an action-centered Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) with an action-only diffusion loop.

The released transformer is a pretrained initialization rather than a finished task policy: deploying it for a task additionally needs local post-training statistics and, where applicable, a task-finetuned transformer directory. It draws on shared Wan2.2 assets alongside the policy transformer. All Hub assets must be staged locally before it runs, and network access and custom remote code are disabled at runtime for reproducibility.

In WorldFoundry, GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 runs in-process from staged assets for action prediction and world-action-model tasks; torch.compile is applied to the action-only MoT blocks and can be turned off in the runtime config.
zh: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 是 GigaAI(open-gigaai)推出的视觉-语言-动作策略,属于世界-动作模型家族。它预测机器人动作,核心是一个以动作为中心的 Mixture-of-Transformers(MoT),配合仅作用于动作的扩散循环。
已发布的 transformer 是预训练初始化,而非成品任务策略:要将它部署到某个任务,还需要本地的后训练统计量,以及在适用时提供一个任务微调后的 transformer 目录。它在策略 transformer 之外还使用共享的 Wan2.2 资产。运行前所有 Hub 资产都必须在本地准备好,运行时会关闭网络访问与自定义远程代码以保证可复现。
在 WorldFoundry 中,GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 从准备好的资产在进程内运行,用于动作预测与世界-动作模型任务;torch.compile 仅作用于 action-only 的 MoT 模块,并可在运行配置中关闭。

whenToUse.en: Reach for it when you want a world-action VLA with a Mixture-of-Transformers design as a pretrained starting point to fine-tune toward a specific manipulation task.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个采用 Mixture-of-Transformers 设计的世界-动作 VLA,作为预训练起点、微调到具体操作任务时,可以选择它。

notFor.en: The released transformer is an initialization, not a ready policy — task deployment needs post-training statistics and often a task-finetuned transformer. It also relies on shared Wan2.2 assets, all staged locally.
notFor.zh: 已发布的 transformer 是初始化而非可用策略——任务部署需要后训练统计量,通常还需一个任务微调后的 transformer。它还依赖共享的 Wan2.2 资产,全部需在本地准备。

en: Action-centered Mixture-of-Transformers with a diffusion action loop
Pretrained initialization for downstream task fine-tuning
Runs fully offline from locally staged assets
zh: 来自 GigaAI(open-gigaai)的世界-动作 VLA
